name: Sweaty Dyno
empireRule: The Empire Pot rolls over every season, funded by an annual set-aside from buy-ins. It is claimed by the first manager to win 2 titles, OR to win 1 title and reach 50+ empire points. If a 2x champion is crowned in the same season another manager reaches 50 points, the 2x champion wins. Once won, the league resets with a 5 asset keeper/dispersal draft.

sleeper.note: Sleeper league_id per season, from the league URL: sleeper.com/leagues/<league_id>/team. autoSync pulls new weekly scores and final standings when a signed-in commissioner opens the app, at most once every autoSyncHours. Sleeper's read API is public and CORS-open, so this needs no server and no keys.

_placementNote: Amount per finishing place. Add a season key (e.g. "2027": {"1":100,"2":50,"3":25}) to override the default for that year.
_minigameBudgetNote: What the rules allow for minigames and awards in a season. Add a season key to override (e.g. "2027": 250). The Games tab compares this against what you have actually committed.
